description: The new FP32 intermediate option is not supported end-to-end by GatedMLP.forward.
trigger: Construct GatedMLP with interm_dtype=torch.float32 and run forward with otherwise valid FP16 inputs.
expected_behavior: Gate/up outputs should be activated and consumed by the down projection with a compatible dtype, or the unsupported setting should be rejected before computation.
actual_behavior: Gate and up projections allocate FP32 outputs. silu_mul and gelu_mul perform no dtype checks and reinterpret their buffers as half pointers. Their kernel processes numel/2 half2 values, not numel FP32 values. The tensor remains tagged FP32 afterward. A dense down projection then fails hgemm's FP16 input check; an EXL3 down projection first performs a supported float Hadamard but subsequently fails the same FP16-input requirement in either GEMM route. No shipped model constructor enables interm_dtype, so this concerns the new opt-in setting rather than every model workflow.

finding.description: Existing in-place activation callers do not implement the new FP32-input/FP16-output contract.
finding.trigger: Run GatedMLP with FP32 gate/up intermediates, or BlockSparseMLP with FP32 intermediates on its ordinary expert path (bsz > 1 or not fully quantized).
finding.expected_behavior: The supported FP32 intermediate setting supplies a half activation destination for the subsequent down projection.
finding.actual_behavior: Both paths pass u as the destination while u remains FP32. The newly added z dtype check rejects the call before launching the activation kernel. This changes the inherited failure from incorrect half-pointer interpretation to explicit rejection; the fused BlockSparseMLP path already has a separate half destination.

verification.limits: Conditional opt-in paths; no model or CUDA execution and no claim that every workflow enables FP32 intermediates.

finding.description: GatedMLP's opt-in FP32 intermediate path remains incompatible with the activation destination contract.
finding.trigger: Construct GatedMLP with interm_dtype=torch.float and execute forward with otherwise valid inputs.
finding.expected_behavior: Supply a half activation destination before the down projection.
finding.actual_behavior: GatedMLP passes float u as both up input and destination; silu_mul or gelu_mul rejects z's dtype before reaching the clamp. No located shipped GatedMLP constructor enables this setting. BlockSparseMLP's ordinary path now uses a separate half destination and does not retain this mismatch.

fixes.rationale: GatedMLP now supplies a separate half activation destination when interm_dtype is not torch.half, and feeds that destination to down. Explicit half aliases u; default None also allocates. This repairs the opt-in FP32 destination mismatch.
fixes.limits: Source-level destination contract fix only. No shipped builder enables FP32; no CUDA/model/backend-wide runtime validation. Does not repair the odd-element kernel tail.
